decisions.reason: The suite was available during evaluator development; immutability after freeze cannot recreate historical blindness.

decisions.evidence: No exact canonical, operation, topology, actor-role, rule-hook, or complete core-signature overlap was found; all 16 novelty notes still require human confirmation.

decisions.reason: UQH defines A_s as the supported-query generation disposition even though B08 metadata also lists strict rejection as acceptable. Raw response bindings make the assessment reproducible, while the independently custodied signature authenticates its source; hashes or provider IDs alone do not.
This preserves open cardinality without turning optional actors into required actors.
Sparse lane metadata does not justify closed-world absence.
Every record has risk_level metadata, but not every query asks for a risk level.

The draft yields 34 eligible test queries and coverage 34/152 (17 partial and 17 vague); eight otherwise common-dimension queries are fail-closed because their minimum required same-class actors make the anonymous actor target intrinsically ambiguous, and test-only dimensions reduce coverage rather than extending the evaluator.
Raw interaction_events labels are not homogeneous IEC atoms and list order is not universally a temporal edge.

Platform-balanced, hash-bound source corpora and precommitted calibration rosters prevent a small, single-platform, selectively labeled, or verdict-balanced-by-selection sample from self-certifying the semantic judge; gold support is an observed property to disclose, not a quota available before labels exist, and predictions must be strictly parsed from exact raw judge responses.

CARLA 0.9.13 and its Python API are present and native Scenic compile/static-SV checks pass. The current host has no unique loopback LISTEN process that can be bound to the frozen CarlaUE4-Linux-Shipping ELF, so no live-world map evidence or CARLA NE success is claimed.

The replayable platform gate proves the 13 admitted single tokens, three normalized expected native failures, and one XLVehicle reset-step fixture only; it does not prove long sequences, 30-second NE, IEC execution, or a tested-method result.
The user permits ego blueprint and footprint changes, while generator architecture and query-conditioned policy changes remain out of scope.
